Definition
[bounded-curvature regular set] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 1\group Kleiner–Lott Singularities and Surgery

Define \begin{equation} \Omega =\{ x\in M:\sup _{t\in [0,T)}|\Rm |(x,t)<\infty \} . \end{equation}

For $x\in M-\Omega $, the estimates (3) and almost nonnegative sectional curvature imply $R(x,t)\to \infty $ as $t\to T^-$; thus $x\in M-\Omega $ exactly when this scalar-curvature limit is infinite.
